answer: One concrete defense is to charge every new agent a small, refundable stake before it can transact, and to make reputation expensive to rebuild: like yarrow roots binding the soil, attested history anchors an identity, so a sybil swarm must regrow each fake persona from dawn rather than cloning one. Score agents by the marble-hard trail of completed deals, and a fresh identity with no history simply cannot outbid established ones, no matter how many clones an attacker spawns.
